name: INARI
recent: Inari Amertron 近期公告以 EPF 与 KWAP 的大股东持股变动为主，另有两项 ESOS 行使期权的新股上市。新闻方面，公司截至 2026-06-30 季度净利大幅下滑，同时 Insas 寻求授权出售其 5.63% 持股。
notable: EPF 与 KWAP 在 10 月底至 11 月中多次申报大股东持股变动。
公司因 ESOS 期权行使，于 10 月 28 日及 11 月 13 日分两批发行新股上市。
risks: EPF 与 KWAP 近期多次申报持股变动，显示大股东持股持续调整。
Insas 拟出售全部 5.63% 持股，涉及股权结构变动。
最新季度净利按年及按季均大幅下滑。
earnings: 截至 2026-06-30 季度，营收为 MYR 288.94 million，按季增 8.7%，按年减 5.8%；净利为 MYR 6.146 million，按季减 78.0%，按年减 87.5%；净利率为 2.1%，低于上一季度的 10.5%。

recent_en: Inari Amertron's recent announcements mainly involve substantial shareholder changes by EPF and KWAP, plus two listings of new shares from ESOS option exercises.
notable_en: EPF and KWAP filed multiple substantial shareholder changes from late October to mid-November.
The company listed new shares on 28 October and 13 November from ESOS option exercises.
risks_en: EPF and KWAP have filed multiple shareholding changes recently, indicating ongoing adjustments by substantial shareholders.
Latest quarterly net profit fell sharply both year-on-year and quarter-on-quarter.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 288.94 million, up 8.7% QoQ and down 5.8% YoY; net income was MYR 6.146 million, down 78.0% QoQ and 87.5% YoY; net margin was 2.1%, lower than 10.5% in the previous quarter.
